public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = scanner.nextDouble();
        double y = scanner.nextDouble();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();

        double p = 0;
        double s = 1;
        for (double i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            double a = Math.floor((x / y) * i);
            long t = (long) Math.ceil((x / y) * i);
            if (Math.abs((x / y) - a / i) < Math.abs((x / y) - p / s)) {
                p = a;
                s = i;
            }
            if (Math.abs((x / y) - t / i) < Math.abs((x / y) - p / s)) {
                p = t;
                s = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println((long) p + "/" + (long) s);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
